title: The Tracegate platform data sheet
summary: A concise look at the connected security model, three platform capabilities, and the workflow from evidence to a reviewable change.
headline: The whole platform. One clear picture.
intro: Cloud exposures. Identity permissions. The paths between them. Explore the Tracegate platform concept in a concise, shareable overview.
takeaways: How configuration, identity, and resource context connect
What each of the three capabilities brings to a review
How evidence becomes an owned, reviewable intervention

capabilities.title: Attack path analysis
capabilities.copy: Connect an exposed workload, a permission relationship, and a sensitive target. Inspect the evidence behind each possible step before deciding what to change.

capabilities.title: Identity security
capabilities.copy: Understand effective access for human and machine identities. Keep purpose, ownership, grants, and resource sensitivity together in the review.

capabilities.title: Cloud security posture
capabilities.copy: Keep configuration findings in view, then add ownership and relationship context. Use baseline checks alongside connected-path investigation.

workflow.title: Discover
workflow.copy: Bring configuration, identity, and resource observations into a shared model. Preserve collection gaps and observation times.

workflow.title: Understand
workflow.copy: Review effective relationships, target sensitivity, and ownership. Distinguish possible access from observed activity.

workflow.title: Intervene
workflow.copy: Propose a specific scope change, identify its owner, and document dependencies, approval, rollback, and verification.

boundary: Tracegate is a fictional portfolio company. This data sheet describes a product concept using synthetic examples. It does not document a live service, operational connectors, customer outcomes, or certifications.
